status: behavioral acceptance specifications, not passing application tests

cases.given: Two projects and media items have identical names and timestamps.
cases.when: Open or reference one by its ID.
cases.then: Only that ID is addressed; no title/time-based merge occurs.

cases.given: Image A produced edit B; B produced edit C.
cases.then: D has A as primary parent; B and C remain with their original source IDs.

cases.given: Image C is used to generate clip V.
cases.then: V still records and displays C as its source.

cases.given: A four-output request has slots 1 through 4.
cases.then: Cards retain slot numbers; failure 1 remains visible; results do not renumber.

cases.given: An item has preferred version A and unfavorited result B.
cases.when: B completes, then the creator favorites B.
cases.then: Completion does not change preference; favorite changes only B's marker.

cases.given: Request Q1 produced A; later Q2 and Q3 produced other results.
cases.when: Edit and run Q1 again with changed words.
cases.then: New Q4 records revisesRequestId Q1 and Q1's original parent context; Q1-Q3 and their outputs remain.

cases.given: Q1 is accepted before Q2 but finishes afterward.
cases.when: Observe both results and a duplicate Q1 completion event.
cases.then: History stays Q1 then Q2; each output appears once under its originating request.

cases.given: Image A is owned in project P and referenced in conversations X and Y.
cases.when: Submit one edit from each conversation.
cases.then: Both requests reference exact A; histories remain distinct and no storage duplicate is required.

cases.given: Request Q and media A are accepted/stored.
cases.when: Rename project, conversation and media title.
cases.then: Request hash, original words, media bytes and ancestry are unchanged.

cases.given: A project gallery is open with no active conversation.
cases.when: Choose Edit on A twice during destination creation.
cases.then: One idempotent destination conversation/draft is created; no generation occurs.

cases.given: Library image A belongs to project P while Q is active.
cases.then: Create an owned Q copy, preserve P's original, and do not copy private conversation instructions or alter Q's active draft.

cases.given: Draft X edits A; viewer shows B.
cases.when: Open B fullscreen and close it.
cases.then: Draft X's source, instructions, model, context and destination remain unchanged.

cases.given: Result B was an edit of A under request Q.
cases.when: Choose Make another variation on B.
cases.then: New draft copies Q's original A input; next result is an alternative from A, not an edit of B.

cases.given: A-to-B-to-C edits exist; another branch from A requested blue lighting.
cases.then: Context contains B's ancestor path and new instruction; C's later edits and the blue sibling instruction are excluded.

cases.given: A is primary base and B is a visual reference with unrelated history.
cases.then: Record both inputs and roles; B's conversation instructions are excluded unless explicitly selected as context.

cases.given: An old request used project instruction revision N; project is now N+1.
cases.then: Draft retains N and shows the available update; N+1 is applied only explicitly.

cases.given: Composer targets A while the viewer shows B.
cases.when: Send Make it darker with Edit image selected.
cases.then: The visible bound input A is used; viewing B supplies no target change.

cases.given: No unique media input is bound and several result batches exist.
cases.then: A persisted clarification asks which request/slot; no media dispatch occurs.

cases.given: A meaningful draft edits A with branch context.
cases.then: Old draft is parked; new draft has no media target or conversation-specific context and retains the chosen project-instruction revision.

cases.given: A branch context exceeds the selected model's catalog limit.
cases.then: Submission is context_limit blocked; no hidden truncation or automatic summary occurs.

cases.given: A proposed summary covers context requests Q1-Q9.
cases.then: New draft revision records summary text and covered IDs; original history remains; no generation runs.

cases.given: One draft and one accepted request use project instructions N.
cases.then: Existing draft shows update availability but keeps N; accepted request remains immutable.

cases.given: Wording assistance was requested for draft revision 4; revision 5 now exists.
cases.then: Show a diff tied to revision 4; do not overwrite revision 5; deliberate Apply creates one undoable revision.

cases.given: A clarification targets draft D revision 4.
cases.when: Answer after D advanced to revision 5.
cases.then: Save the answer as an immutable entry and stale proposal; only Apply as new draft or explicit resolution may use it.

cases.given: Two questions in the same conversation await answers.
cases.when: Send an answer without a unique question reference.
cases.then: Ask which question; neither target draft changes and neither request runs.

cases.given: Draft uses A's history and pixels.
cases.when: Replace its primary image with unrelated B inside the draft.
cases.then: Show input/context difference and block submit until the creator chooses B's directions or explicitly keeps A's directions.

cases.given: An owned legacy image has no producing-request/settings snapshot.
cases.when: Choose View, then attempt exact Reuse, then choose Edit.
cases.then: View works; exact Reuse is unavailable; Edit opens with unknown/empty historical context and requires new instructions.

cases.given: A mask is bound to image A at dimensions and transform T.
cases.when: Replace A with B or crop/rotate/resize A.
cases.then: The mask is invalid until explicitly redrawn/remapped; it cannot silently apply to different pixels.

cases.given: An active draft contains custom text and settings.
cases.then: Park the old draft and open a new explicit-target draft; reopening the old draft restores its content.

cases.given: Active draft has only untouched defaults.
cases.then: Replace the empty draft without creating a parked empty entry.

cases.given: Request Q runs from draft D revision 3.
cases.when: Type a new follow-up and change settings.
cases.then: Save a separate draft/revision while Q's accepted snapshot remains revision 3.

cases.given: Two tabs display the same saved draft ID/revision.
cases.when: Both submit simultaneously with different client submission IDs.
cases.then: Atomic draft-revision uniqueness produces one receipt, reservation and execution; mismatching hashes conflict.

cases.given: A single supported image edit is running.
cases.when: Type another edit in the visibly waiting follow-up draft.
cases.then: Pending input is Q's exact slot; submit stays disabled until its original-project durable result exists.

cases.given: A follow-up draft waits on Q's slot and already contains text.
cases.when: Q completes successfully and attaches to its original project.
cases.then: Resolve only the declared input; preserve words/settings; do not auto-submit or move the viewer.

cases.given: A follow-up draft waits on Q.
cases.when: Q definitively fails or its output is lost.
cases.then: Keep follow-up words and failed dependency; offer choose input/reuse setup; never substitute Q's original source automatically.

cases.given: A batch produces four images; slot 2 is ready while others run.
cases.then: Bind slot 2 exactly and permit an otherwise valid request; other slots keep their identities/statuses.

cases.given: Draft X waits on Q, then the creator starts independent draft Y.
cases.then: Update parked X's declared dependency and Q's history only; active Y/viewer/navigation remain unchanged.

cases.given: Text has undo history; a generation has already completed.
cases.when: Press Undo in the text field, then type a new edit.
cases.then: Undo affects text only; result and charge remain; new text clears only that draft's redo path.

cases.given: Revision 8 is being saved; revision 9 is typed.
cases.then: Revision 9 remains unsaved/remotely pending; the old ack cannot label it Saved.

cases.given: Local checkpointing fails but current revision 9 is acknowledged on the server.
cases.then: Navigation is allowed with accurate storage status; no forced export/discard of remotely safe work.

cases.given: A video edit at revision 7 has an export in progress.
cases.then: Create revision 8 with revision 3's contents; export continues rendering revision 7.

cases.given: Newest draft revision is neither locally checkpointed nor server-acknowledged.
cases.when: Try to leave through app navigation/sign-out.
cases.then: Offer retry, explicit draft export/continue, or discard; do not claim work is saved.

cases.given: A video request, export, download, or text-assistance request completes.
cases.then: No implicit next image/video edit target is created; export keeps source editor; download keeps draft; text produces an explicit proposal.

cases.given: A catalog entry lacks a capability, cost bound or mandatory recovery deadline.
cases.when: Try to run the affected action.
cases.then: Action is unavailable with the missing-policy/capability reason; no permissive fallback occurs.

cases.given: Client shows a source as valid but ownership changed before submit.
cases.then: Server denies before accepting executable work and preserves the draft; stale UI grants nothing.

cases.given: A draft has no authorization, a conflict and a missing input.
cases.then: Show all three reasons with authorization primary; submit remains disabled.

cases.given: A valid image-animation draft has model-specific duration and inputs.
cases.then: Preserve old revision and show unresolved values; no silent clamp/removal; require explicit resolution.

cases.given: A reviewed request asks for two outputs.
cases.when: Assistant or provider proposes four after acceptance.
cases.then: Do not increase accepted slots/spend; additional work requires a new reviewed request.

cases.given: A proposed multi-step request still needs an uncreated intermediate image.
cases.when: Try to run the later step.
cases.then: Keep that step a draft until an exact valid input exists; no hidden dependency scheduling occurs.

cases.given: The creator selects Ask or Improve wording.
cases.when: Submit a description of desired media.
cases.then: Return text/proposal only; no image/video generation occurs until the explicit media action is run.

cases.given: A frozen request was accepted under submission S and hash H.
cases.then: Return its same receipt; no second reservation, queue item or provider execution.

cases.given: Submission S is bound to hash H.
cases.when: Send S with different instruction/input hash K.
cases.then: Reject identity conflict; neither original snapshot nor job is overwritten.

cases.given: Submit request timed out without a receipt.
cases.when: Reload, reconnect and press Check status.
cases.then: Restore envelope/S; query acceptance; recover existing receipt or resend identical S only after proven absence.

cases.given: Server definitively rejects before acceptance because authentication expired.
cases.then: Preserve draft; no automatic generation; creator submits the restored valid revision deliberately.

cases.given: A worker lease expires after a provider may have accepted.
cases.then: Reconcile original attempt; do not make a second external generation call solely because the lease expired.

cases.given: A generation failed before provider acceptance with proof and retry budget remaining.
cases.then: Retain original reviewed inputs/model and maximum usage; record attempt; never silently switch provider or creative settings.

cases.given: Provider may have accepted, or another provider would be required.
cases.then: Do not regenerate; reconcile or offer a new explicit reviewed request.

cases.given: Provider returned an image but durable storage failed.
cases.then: Show Made; saving needs attention; retry the same output; no Ready claim or duplicate generation/charge.

cases.given: Stored output cannot attach to a trashed/missing original project.
cases.then: Show Ready in recovery; preserve original destination; allow owned download/copy; no silently created project.

cases.given: Two of four slots are ready and one failed while one is running.
cases.then: Keep in progress with counts; do not mark partial terminal until the last slot resolves.

cases.given: Two slots are ready, one failed and one cancelled.
cases.then: Mark partial and keep both ready outputs and both terminal slot records.

cases.given: No output is ready and every slot is cancelled.
cases.then: Mark cancelled; retain slot IDs and cancellation evidence.

cases.given: No output is ready; some slots failed and others cancelled.
cases.then: Mark failed with per-slot details; do not claim a fully cancelled request.

cases.given: Saving failed and the provider output has now expired irrecoverably.
cases.then: Record output_lost; disable impossible same-output repair; new generation is a new explicit request.

cases.given: Slot is stored at server revision 12.
cases.when: Receive revision 10 Running, then duplicate revision 12.
cases.then: Do not revert or duplicate it; ignore/log stale observations.

cases.given: Two authoritative events claim contradictory terminal outcomes.
cases.then: Keep evidence/media and enter reconciliation; callback timestamp cannot choose truth.

cases.given: A queued job has not dispatched externally.
cases.then: Server atomic order decides: confirmed pre-dispatch cancellation releases usage, otherwise request provider cancellation and retain execution status.

cases.given: Cancellation was requested but not confirmed.
cases.then: Keep result; label completion-before-cancel; apply accepted usage policy; do not change active draft/selection.

cases.given: Cancellation was confirmed and customer usage released.
cases.then: Store/reconcile the result and provider expense; never re-debit released customer usage.

cases.given: A batch has ready, running and unstarted slots.
cases.when: Cancel remaining work or close the browser.
cases.then: Explicit cancel affects named remaining slots; ready results stay; closing alone cancels nothing.

cases.given: An accepted request reaches its captured recovery deadline with uncertain provider outcome.
cases.then: Show Needs attention, retain evidence and release unsettled customer reservation; do not label provider failure or automatically regenerate.

cases.given: A request's usage was released after recovery expiry.
cases.then: Deliver the owned result without re-debit; preserve recovery history and provider expense.

cases.given: Assistant response is streaming against draft revision 4.
cases.then: Show incomplete text and reconcile the same text request; partial text cannot be Applied as a final proposal.

cases.given: A local file has a familiar extension but unsupported actual content.
cases.then: Reject content before it becomes a usable input; preserve draft role and explain the reason.

cases.given: An upload response is lost.
cases.when: Retry with the same import identity.
cases.then: Recover/resume one logical item; do not create another media item from a transport retry.

cases.given: A draft references staged bytes that were not recoverable after reload.
cases.when: Reselect a file of the same name with different bytes.
cases.then: Do not resume old identity as if identical; create a new input revision or require matching bytes.

cases.given: Two drafts reference one in-progress upload.
cases.when: Remove it from only draft A.
cases.then: Draft B and the upload continue; A's removed role does not return on completion.

cases.given: A shared upload is still running.
cases.when: Explicitly cancel after reviewing affected drafts; output arrives late.
cases.then: Affected references remain unavailable/removed; late file is a project item with no automatic draft reattachment.

cases.given: A stored version's signed URL expires.
cases.then: Resolve the same durable handle to a fresh authorized URL; do not regenerate or change version identity.

cases.given: Media access is denied.
cases.when: Try an old cached URL or a related viewer action.
cases.then: Do not bypass authorization; show unavailable reference while preserving history.

cases.given: A decoded clip is paused at 3 seconds.
cases.then: Same clip/time/pause state remains; choosing another version starts that version at zero.

cases.given: Autoplay is refused or video buffering/decode fails.
cases.then: Expose Play/retry playback; generation remains successful; images do not show active clip playback.

cases.given: Sketch has a last successful preview and a newer pending drawing.
cases.when: A new frame fails and then creator leaves Sketch.
cases.then: Retain labeled last output; pause dispatch on leave; current project request is unchanged.

cases.given: Sketch displays output O1 while O2 is arriving.
cases.when: Press Accept twice and lose the response.
cases.then: One acceptance records O1's exact drawing/settings/destination; recover same receipt; O2 cannot substitute.

cases.given: Sketch has an unaccepted drawing and preview at close.
cases.then: Offer locally saved drawing/settings; do not claim preview history saved or restart generation automatically; accepted outputs remain durable.

cases.given: Sketch reaches its existing server allowance.
cases.when: Try more frames or accept an already displayed output.
cases.then: Disable new frame dispatch until authorized reset; preserve drawing/output; acceptance does not create retroactive customer charges.

cases.given: Video edit uses exact clip versions A1 and B1.
cases.when: A2 and B2 are later generated/preferred.
cases.then: The edit still uses A1/B1 until an explicit replacement revision.

cases.given: Edit contains invalid trim bounds, zero length or inaccessible input.
cases.then: Block export with each offending element identified; keep editable saved work.

cases.given: Output aspect ratio changes from landscape to portrait.
cases.then: Require visible fit/fill/crop choices; no silent stretching or off-screen text.

cases.given: Creator requests generated music, automatic captions or unsupported effect.
cases.then: Show capability unavailable; manual captions/imported audio remain supported; do not simulate unavailable features.

cases.given: Saved edit revision 7 begins export.
cases.when: Change text and trim to revision 8 while export runs.
cases.then: Export captures revision 7; show newer edit exists; revision 8 can have a separate export.

cases.given: An export render definitively failed.
cases.then: Create new request retryOf original with same edit/source versions and reviewed cost; never regenerate source clips.

cases.given: Export rendered successfully but storage/attachment response failed.
cases.then: Recover same export/media ID; do not start a new render.

cases.given: A 5-second timeline item is replaced by a 3-second clip.
cases.then: Keep pending change invalid until explicit Change duration or Cancel; preview timing effects before applying.

cases.given: An export's pinned source becomes inaccessible.
cases.then: Pause/reconcile then fail with missing source if not recoverable; keep edit and never use an unauthorized stale URL.

cases.given: Clip A has 5 seconds followed by clip B; caption is attached to B.
cases.then: B and its attached caption shift earlier by 2 seconds; background audio's composition-time anchor does not shift.

cases.given: Text attached to a clip extends past a newly shortened clip interval.
cases.then: Keep text element, mark edit invalid and require explicit timing change/removal; do not silently delete it.

cases.given: A clip is inserted, removed or reordered.
cases.then: Restore that single edit action as a new saved revision; media/history/jobs remain unchanged.

cases.given: A clip has source audio and the background track is occupied.
cases.then: Explain track-capacity conflict and make detach unavailable; mute/volume remain explicit supported changes.

cases.given: A project has saved draft changes, running jobs and an unrelated viewed image.
cases.then: Restore each independently; reconstruct nonterminal jobs from server receipts rather than a local polling flag.

cases.given: The app is offline with an editable cached draft.
cases.then: No silent queued dispatch; replay safe saves/reconcile accepted work only; a never-accepted generation needs visible submit.

cases.given: Two tabs edit draft base revision 5.
cases.then: First accepted write wins revision; second is a retained conflict copy; preserve both and block submit from conflict.

cases.given: A conflict shows local and server content.
cases.when: Choose Keep mine as separate draft or Use server version.
cases.then: Keep the losing content as a recoverable copy; never last-write-win silently.

cases.given: One tab accepts draft revision 5 while another still shows it.
cases.when: Second tab learns the receipt or tries to edit/submit.
cases.then: Mark frozen revision submitted; create/open another draft before further edits; intentional rerun requires copied draft.

cases.given: Account A has an unknown submission and local work.
cases.when: Session expires, then account B signs in.
cases.then: Do not expose/adopt A's private data in B; A's server job can continue and reconciles only under A.

cases.given: An anonymous draft exists and the signed-in account has another draft.
cases.then: Keep both; do not overwrite either based on recency.

cases.given: Local-only drafts exist before sign-out.
cases.when: Sign out after checkpoint status is shown.
cases.then: Lock same-owner drafts and clear rendered private content; no encryption claim and no cross-account adoption.

cases.given: Project loading transiently fails or known destination is gone.
cases.then: Retry same ID for transient errors; offer restore/copy for missing destination; never silently create a replacement project.

cases.given: Queue capacity/provider service is unavailable before acceptance.
cases.then: Refuse without publishing executable work; preserve draft and show cause; existing accepted receipts remain tracked.

cases.given: An input is bound in the composer.
cases.when: Filter, sort, rename or favorite items so it leaves the visible gallery.
cases.then: Input remains explicitly bound and visible in composer; request order/history is unchanged.

cases.given: Version A has children and is used by a draft/export/share.
cases.then: Gallery hides it; dependencies/history and existing share still reference A; Show hidden/Restore can reveal it.

cases.given: A conversation has draft text and a running job.
cases.then: Keep work/history/jobs; conversation is read-only until restore; no implicit job cancellation.

cases.given: Project has pending and running jobs plus public shares.
cases.then: Block new writes and deny public links; cancel unstarted work. Outputs already attached stay in retained trash; outputs finishing after trash deliver through owner recovery with original target preserved.

cases.given: A trashed project had cancelled jobs and revoked shares.
cases.then: Restore identities/work; do not restart jobs or reactivate old links.

cases.given: Creator opens historical-message or asset removal actions.
cases.then: Those destructive actions are unavailable; offered Hide/Archive/Trash accurately describe their behavior.

cases.given: A public link points at immutable export E7.
cases.when: Export E8 and mark it preferred.
cases.then: Old link still targets E7; publishing E8 requires another link.

cases.given: A share publication response is lost.
cases.then: Recover publication by operation ID; do not create duplicate links.

cases.given: Link revocation times out.
cases.then: Show Revocation pending/unknown; do not claim revoked until authoritative denial; retry same revocation.

cases.given: Project trash commits while individual link cleanup is retrying.
cases.then: Authoritative access denies it even before cleanup completes.

cases.given: Stored output is ready.
cases.when: Download fails or browser transfer starts.
cases.then: Report transfer state only; no generation/export failure or additional charge; no claim of a completed disk write.

cases.given: Reviewed quote expires before server acceptance.
cases.then: Reject/requote before dispatch; preserve draft and require review of the new amount.

cases.given: Quote is accepted/reserved, then expires while queued.
cases.then: Honor captured maximum; no silent reprice; incompatible provider cost requires failure/release or a new explicit request.

cases.given: Two different requests compete for the last allowance.
cases.then: Atomic reservation permits only the affordable work; duplicate settlements/reservations remain impossible.

cases.given: Four slots have distinct usage allocations; two deliver, one fails, one cancels.
cases.then: Charge only deliverable policy-eligible slots and release failed/cancelled allocations; record all actual provider expense separately.

cases.given: A technically delivered result is disliked by its creator.
cases.then: Show new attempt/cost; original successful delivery remains settled and preserved.

cases.given: Output is durable but neither project nor recovery inbox association is confirmed.
cases.then: Hold unsettled reservation while within deadline; settle only after authoritative owned delivery; no regeneration.

cases.given: A delivered result needs status, attachment or transfer recovery.
cases.then: No new generation reservation or customer charge is created.

cases.given: Allowance is exhausted while ready outputs and drafts exist.
cases.when: Browse/download existing output and edit text.
cases.then: Permit existing access/drafting; block only new billable work with the exact allowance reason.

cases.given: Submission acceptance remains unknown at its captured deadline.
cases.when: Automatic reconciliation expires and the creator checks later.
cases.then: Keep the frozen envelope in Needs attention; check the same ID; only authoritative absence permits resend; no rejection/failure is invented.

cases.given: An owned result is in recovery because original project attachment failed.
cases.when: Copy it to project Q, then repair its original project P link.
cases.then: Copy admission in Q and repaired original in P have distinct explicit associations; original request target stays P; neither recovery path creates another provider generation.

cases.given: Media draft D revision 4 is unchanged after asking for wording advice; video edit E revision 7 is saved.
cases.when: Generate from D and export E in two different presets using separate action drafts.
cases.then: Assistance does not consume D; exports consume their own settings drafts, not E. Same execution draft submitted from two tabs still converges to one receipt.

cases.given: Creator opens a new request without selecting inputs.
cases.when: Inspect the composer and then choose an action.
cases.then: One output, no implicit media selection, and visible captured catalog defaults apply; Run is unavailable until an action and all required inputs exist.

cases.given: Result B was generated from A with a known seed.
cases.when: Choose Make another variation and then retry its transport.
cases.then: The new draft visibly uses a fresh seed policy with the original A input; frozen per-slot seeds stay identical through transport retries. No exact-pixel replay guarantee is made.

cases.given: Provider nonacceptance and nonbilling are proven within accepted retry budget.
cases.then: The same slot returns to waiting with a new attempt record, not a new request or increased cost bound; an unknown external outcome never enters this transition.

cases.given: A slot was classified failed/lost, or already holds a stored version.
cases.when: A newly verified late provider output arrives.
cases.then: Failed/lost slots can recover the verified output; a stored slot never replaces its bytes. Different extra bytes are retained separately in recovery without new slot or charge.

cases.given: Sketch allowance is exhausted but a valid successful output remains displayed.
cases.then: Accept that exact existing output through admission; do not dispatch another preview or charge for historical frames.

cases.given: An assistance question targets draft D revision 4, which is submitted unchanged before its answer arrives.
cases.when: The answer arrives and the creator tries Apply.
cases.then: Treat the proposal as non-applicable despite matching revision; never mutate accepted D. Offer a separate authorized writable draft or retain/discard the proposal.
